column3: Close to the Hebrew; “I will visit on you” is rendered “I will punish you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have met by appointment” is rendered “they are agreed.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the two trap words the other way around (“snare … trap”).
Close to the Hebrew; “to the fortresses” is rendered “in the palaces,” and “oppressions” “the oppressed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “straightforwardness” is rendered “right,” and “devastation” “robbery.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will bring down your strength” is rendered “He shall sap your strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with the silk (or damask) of a couch” is rendered “on the edge of a couch,” and “be delivered” “be taken out”; the meaning of the word is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “warn” is rendered “testify against.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will visit the transgressions” is rendered “I punish Israel for their transgressions,” and “I will visit [them] on the altars” “I will also visit destruction on the altars.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the great houses will be swept away” is rendered “the great houses shall have an end.”
